 Match Preview
 Major League Soccer - Game Week 33 Oct 31, 2026 - 18:30 Dick's Sporting Goods Park Colorado Rapids host Chicago Fire FC at Dick's Sporting Goods Park in Commerce City in a Western Conference Major League Soccer fixture with contrasting stakes for each side.
 Matt Wells's Rapids sit seventh in the Western Conference, a position that keeps their playoff hopes alive but leaves little room for error as the regular season enters its final stretch. Their last five matches have produced just one win, with three draws reflecting a squad capable of grinding out points but struggling to convert pressure into victories.
 Chicago Fire arrive in Colorado fourth in the Eastern Conference with their playoff place already secured. Gregg Berhalter's side drew 2-2 with Orlando City in their most recent outing, a result that extended a mixed run of form after earlier wins over Atlanta United and New York City FC.
 The Fire's most recent away fixture ended in a 2-3 win at Atlanta United, a result that showed Berhalter's men can perform on the road. That said, back-to-back draws against Orlando and now a trip west means momentum has levelled off at a critical point in the season.
 For Colorado, this is a fixture they need to win. A draw with San Jose Earthquakes in their last outing kept them in the picture, but Wells will know that points dropped at home against a team with nothing to prove could prove costly.
